divergence: All three runs fail the same way at the write stage, as in the previous round. Each found the latest-dated agreement through file listings and extraction scans, read its executed agreement and adjustment section, and cited it correctly, but added a comparison list or table presenting earlier executed agreements as deals with the requested adjustment, which the precision criterion counts as extra qualifying matters. The reviews pushed toward the comparison rows in every run: write-stage reviews asked that every other candidate be listed with its signing date, and check-stage reviews said to keep the matter set. Agent-declared new stages (five, all relabelled as extraction scans, one as a check) were used for completeness sweeps for later-dated agreements and did not change the answer; one label note was followed (T1) and two ignored (T0, T2).
